label: Scene
summary: Keeps the props on stage, which the story changes by asking in a <scene> tag.
instructions: To change the props on stage, write the change in plain words as <scene>put the lantern on the table</scene>.

delegate.summary: Turns <scene> requests in the prose into changes to the props on stage.
delegate.description: The model that reads each <scene> request and places or removes props.
delegate.off: Scene requests are left as written
